rationale: Clarifies scope ambiguity without changing core doctrine; matches product direction that forms runtime is in initial focus and host-awareness is required.
Early vertical slice de-risks architecture by validating end-to-end semantics before full optimization complexity.
Flag-gating risky performance features protects correctness-first value ordering and allows controlled promotion.
Quantitative gates improve planning determinism and operational readiness claims.
Formal risk register makes mitigation explicit and auditable throughout implementation.
Separating backend AOT capability from CLI packaging removes phase overlap ambiguity.
Compatibility matrix is added as a progressive gate model rather than a fixed full matrix upfront, aligning with iterative evidence growth.
Per-phase metadata fields improve execution tracking and parallelization planning.
Foundation recalc alignment is reflected as sequencing rules and evidence language, without importing full Foundation pack taxonomy into OxVBA docs.
Provenance and structure updates keep synthesis history explicit and current.
